Drop element writes nothing for an inline data image

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { inlineDataMedia: InlineDataMedia.DropElement };
  const result = convert("<p>Before <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"icon\"> after</p>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
